role: independent evidence auditor (author of no MC-09 research deliverable)
verdictScope: MC-09 internal desk-research and market-intelligence scope. PARTIAL is conditional on documentation corrections F-01..F-04 and the manifest integration F-06; no BLOCKING finding was found. Commercial release remains BLOCKED / NOT_FOR_SALE.

findings.evidence: The executive summary states 'Ningún competidor vende una solución completa instalada y puesta en servicio equivalente a los bundles de MAREA' as an absolute market fact. The workstream document it summarises is correctly bounded: MC09-BUNDLE-BENCHMARKS.md:13 says 'No observed competitor sells a single installed, commissioned package that matches a MAREA bundle' and its method section (lines 11-21) states the comparisons are compositions of separately sold components. The evidence base is 27 competitor sources and 48 observations, not an exhaustive census; installation is in this market a dealer/installer service sold separately, which the report itself states on line 101.
findings.impact: A universal negative that the sample cannot establish is presented in the decision document as a market gap. A reader could infer that no competitor offers installed/commissioned systems, when what is evidenced is only that no observed product bundles installation into the product price. The strategic conclusion (software-first validation) does not depend on the absolute form.
findings.requiredCorrection: Reword to the observed scope, e.g. 'Ningun competidor observado comercializa un producto completo con instalacion y puesta en servicio incluidas en el precio; la instalacion se vende como servicio de canal aparte', keeping the hedged claim from MC09-BUNDLE-BENCHMARKS.md:13. Do not add new evidence.
findings.verification: Round 1: conflict reproduced from the repository files; correction not yet applied. Subject to round-2 re-verification.

findings.evidence: START-equivalent is computed as Orca Core 2 EUR 649 + Orca Plus EUR 49 = EUR 698 'year one' (line 36, PRC-CMP-049), and the Orca guard-mode comparison as EUR 649 + EUR 149 = EUR 798 'year one' (line 96). SRC-CMP-001 (https://help.getorca.com/en/articles/6541858-subscription-prices-and-functionality, re-opened 2026-10-31) states: 'A year of Smart Navigation is included in the purchase of an Orca Core or an Orca Display.' The same document acknowledges this on line 55 for CRUISE ('+ one year Smart Navigation included'), so the START and PROTECT rows treat the same source inconsistently.
findings.impact: Two of the five competitor year-one totals overstate the competitor's year-one cost by EUR 49 and EUR 149 respectively. The error is conservative against MAREA and does not change the conclusion (the alternatives still cost more than the MAREA hypothesis), but the comparison is not reproducible from the source as written.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use EUR 649 as the year-one START-equivalent and EUR 649 as the year-one Orca guard-mode reference; present 698 / 798 only as explicitly labelled year-two totals with Plus / Smart Navigation. Alternatively state why the included year is deliberately not counted.
findings.verification: Round 1: source page re-opened and quoted; arithmetic reproduced. Subject to round-2 re-verification.

findings.evidence: The source breakdown reads '(20 mercado, 27 competencia, 20 compradores, 6 economia, 38 canales, 5 metodologia MC-10)'. The files contain 20 + 27 + 20 + 5 + 38 + 5 = 115 sources: evidence-economics.json has five sources (SRC-ECO-001, SRC-ECO-002, SRC-ECO-003, SRC-ECO-005, SRC-ECO-006; there is no SRC-ECO-004). MC09-SOURCE-REGISTER.md:16 also states 115. The printed breakdown sums to 116.
findings.impact: A factual count error in the executive report's evidence section; it makes the source census internally inconsistent with the register it cites.
findings.requiredCorrection: Change '6 economia' to '5 economia' (or publish the per-workstream counts exactly as the register holds them).
findings.verification: Round 1: counts reproduced by script over the six evidence files. Subject to round-2 re-verification.

findings.evidence: The manifest purpose for data/buyer-segments.json says 'Eight evidence-based buyer segments'. buyer-segments.json sets archetypeStatus = HYPOTHETICAL_ARCHETYPE for all eight segments, and MC09-BUYER-SEGMENTS.md:14 states 'Every segment is a HYPOTHETICAL_ARCHETYPE: a reasoned description of a buyer type built from publicly observable problems. No archetype is a real [buyer].' The research documents correctly label the personas; the data-contract index does not.
findings.impact: The machine-readable index overstates the epistemic status of the buyer workstream and contradicts the document it points to. A reader relying only on manifest.json would treat hypothetical archetypes as evidence-based segmentation.
findings.requiredCorrection: Reword the manifest purpose to 'Eight hypothetical buyer archetypes (labelled HYPOTHETICAL_ARCHETYPE), not evidence-based segments'.
findings.verification: Round 1: archetypeStatus reproduced for all eight records and cross-checked against the document. Subject to round-2 re-verification.

findings.requiredCorrection: Say '26 entregables (D1-D26): 25 documentos y 22 ficheros de datos JSON' or equivalent.
findings.verification: Round 1: file inventory counted. Subject to round-2 re-verification.

findings.evidence: Residual audit limitations, not research defects: (a) the Getxo varadero tariff PDF (SRC-CHN-004, https://www.getxo.eus/DocsPublic/turismo/Tarifas_del_varadero.pdf) timed out on both attempts, so the '32.02 EUR/h' claim was not re-verified in round 1; (b) the cruisersforum buyer URL (SRC-BUY-002) failed to fetch in this environment once; (c) 62 of 115 sources have no publishedAt value (the contract example includes the field; the validator does not require it), which limits independent publication-date plausibility checks.
findings.impact: Low residual uncertainty in three source checks. None of these sources carries a headline conclusion; the first two were recorded as retrieved on 2026-10-31 by the research team.
findings.requiredCorrection: None mandatory. Optional: record retrieval limitations in the source rows, or re-verify Getxo/forum URLs when the pages are reachable.
findings.verification: Round 1: attempts documented; may be closed as accepted residual risk by the Lead.

findings.evidence: The delivery record and executive report pre-state the milestone result as PASS 'subject to the independent review', while section 6 of the delivery record notes that gate results will only be appended in the delivery-update commit after the review.
findings.impact: No factual error; a process-ordering note. The final milestone status must be taken from the review verdict and recorded in the delivery-update commit, not read from the pre-review text.
findings.requiredCorrection: At delivery-update time set the status from the closed review, fill the exact implementation SHA / PR URL fields in section 8 of MC-09-DELIVERY.md, and append the exact gate results to section 6.
findings.verification: Round 1: confirmed by reading both files; closed automatically when the delivery-update commit is verified.
